_comment: Hand-authored raw SHA-1 tree-object records for assay.isolation._parse_tree.
Each 'body' is a list of hex byte-strings concatenated in order to form the
exact object payload; writing them as explicit bytes is the point, because
the grammar under test has no length prefix and no terminator, so every
malformed case below is only detectable by running off the end of the
buffer. 'oid20' is an arbitrary but well-formed 20-byte object name.
accepted[] entries name the (mode, name, oid) triples _parse_tree must
return; refused[] entries must each raise ERROR/GIT_FAILED.

refused.why: no SP before the name, so the mode field never terminates
no NUL after the name, so the object name has no start
only 19 of the required 20 object-name bytes remain
a zero-length name is not a legal path component
